$ adb -s emulator-5600 shell getprop persist.sys.locale

$ adb -s emulator-5600 shell cmd locale get-app-locales dev.jasonpearson.automobile.playground
Locales for dev.jasonpearson.automobile.playground for user 0 are [fr-FR]
$ adb -s emulator-5600 shell cmd locale get-app-locales dev.jasonpearson.automobile.playground --user 0
Locales for dev.jasonpearson.automobile.playground for user 0 are [fr-FR]
$ adb -s emulator-5600 shell settings get system system_locales
